title: Meetha Swadist Churna
description: Meetha Swadist Churna (Swadishta Virechana Churna) is a pleasant-tasting, sweet laxative powder containing purified sulfur, senna, and fennel for comfortable evacuation. This classical formulation provides a smooth, non-cramping morning bowel movement through gentle stimulation. Ideal for patients with bleeding piles avoiding harsh stimulation. Suitable for those with anal fissures requiring gentle treatment. Helps with skin rashes prevented by constipation.
dosage: Mixed with lukewarm water strictly before sleep
